name: list_transactions
purpose: Introspect the undo buffer (indices, titles, contexts, object counts, sizes) so an agent can see what its mutations did.
cooked: works — undo buffer is editor state, independent of pak mounting
prevents: bridge mutates constantly with no undo visibility today
hazards: GEditor->Trans can be null (commandlet / -NoTransBuffer) — must error cleanly

name: undo_transactions
purpose: Undo the last N transactions (or down to a queue index) — the rollback half of the gap.
cooked: works — undo state is editor-side
prevents: a bad mutation currently means manual Ctrl-Z at the keyboard
hazards: must NOT run inside blanket FScopedTransaction — ensure(!GIsTransacting) invariant (TransBuffer.h:74)
PostUndo runs Blueprint reinstancing — cached object pointers invalidated; re-resolve paths after undo
world-affecting undo unreliable during PIE — report blocked, stop_pie first
cap N at 50 per call to bound frame time

name: redo_transactions
purpose: Redo the last N undone transactions — lets an agent A/B a change numerically.
cooked: works
hazards: same GIsTransacting invariant as undo — run bare
ANY bridge mutation between undo and redo wipes the redo stack (TransBuffer.h:80-90)

name: list_dirty_packages
purpose: Enumerate every unsaved package (map vs content split) so an agent knows what a crash would lose.
cooked: works — reports which dirty packages are cooked-origin (unsaveable)

name: save_dirty_packages
purpose: One-call checkout-free, prompt-free save of everything dirty.
cooked: degraded — cooked-origin packages skipped and reported; loose packages save normally
prevents: the 'forgot one package before crash' failure class
hazards: MODAL FMessageDialog on any failed save even with bFastSave=true (FileHelpers.cpp:3620-3640)
fast path silently skips read-only and never-saved packages without entering FailedPackages
mid-frame CollectGarbage when content packages included — unrooted UObjects die (cpp:3642-3647)
handler must enumerate + save per-package or guard with GIsRunningUnattendedScript
saving must not sit inside the blanket transaction (FPackageRecord undo pollution)

name: list_actor_folders
purpose: Enumerate the World Outliner folder tree with per-folder actor counts.
cooked: works — folders are editor-world metadata; report what exists, never fail

name: set_actor_folder
purpose: Move actors into an Outliner folder (create on demand); also create/delete/rename folders.
cooked: works — session state; flag unsaveable:true when world package is cooked-origin
hazards: AActor folder API sits inside #if WITH_EDITOR (Actor.h:2353-2579) — plugin is editor-only, fine

name: group_actors
purpose: Create/disband AGroupActor groups so multi-part agent-assembled props move as one unit (pair with ungroup_actors).
cooked: works — same unsaveable-map caveat as set_actor_folder
hazards: GroupActors/UngroupActors open their OWN FScopedTransaction — run bare, don't wrap
grouping disabled in prefs silently ignores — auto-enable via SetGroupingActive and report
actors spanning multiple levels => nullptr return (cpp:58-68) — surface explicit error
group-actor inputs are filtered out; >=2 non-group actors must survive or nullptr

name: list_layers
purpose: Enumerate editor layers with actor counts and visibility — the read half of layer management.
cooked: works

name: modify_actor_layers
purpose: Add/remove actors to/from named layers and toggle layer visibility for bulk show/hide.
cooked: works — layer membership on cooked-map actors is session-only (unsaveable flag)
hazards: do not set AActor::Layers via set_property — bypasses subsystem stats/visibility bookkeeping

name: run_editor_utility
purpose: Execute an Editor Utility Blueprint's Run event by asset path — escape hatch for arbitrary editor logic.
cooked: degraded — loose EUBs only; cooked pak EUBs ship no UBlueprint asset
hazards: EUB graph can do anything — run bare, never inside the blanket transaction (reinstancing crash)
TryRun is synchronous ProcessEvent — long-running EUBs hitch the editor

name: get_cvar
purpose: Structured READ of a console variable — value, type, flags, help — closing the SET-without-GET asymmetry.
cooked: works — console state is process state

name: list_cvars
purpose: Enumerate console variables/commands by prefix or substring with values and flags.
cooked: works
hazards: require a >=2-char filter — a bare walk of ~15k objects building JSON mid-frame hitches

name: list_developer_settings
purpose: Enumerate every UDeveloperSettings subclass (class path, config, category, section) as an index for the set_property CDO route.
cooked: works — class registry is in-process, not pak content
hazards: must ship config-objects scope: viewport prefs derive from UObject, not UDeveloperSettings
abstract-class skips must be reported, not silent

name: get_viewport_state
purpose: Read the active level viewport's render configuration — view mode, game view, realtime, size, show-flag diffs.
cooked: works

name: set_view_mode
purpose: Switch viewport view mode, toggle game view/realtime and individual show flags — makes capture_camera diagnostic.
cooked: works
hazards: viewport state is non-transactional — blanket transaction would push an empty undo entry

name: get_editor_modes
purpose: Report which editor modes are active (Default, Landscape, Foliage, Modeling) before mutating.
cooked: works
prevents: sculpt/paint endpoints behaving differently with a mode left open
hazards: no GetActiveModes() in 5.3.2 — legacy FEdMode actives require probing well-known IDs

name: select_components
purpose: Component-level selection — focuses the details panel and drives per-component gizmos for human handoff.
cooked: works
hazards: base UEditorEngine::SelectComponent is an empty inline stub — must call through GEditor virtual dispatch

name: close_asset_editors
purpose: Close open asset-editor tabs for an asset (or all), and list currently edited assets.
cooked: works — closing editors is independent of asset origin
prevents: open editors making delete_asset/rename_asset fail or prompt
hazards: Slate tab teardown completes next tick — response reports closedRequested, caller re-queries

name: pilot_actor
purpose: Pilot/eject the viewport camera onto an actor so capture_camera can shoot from any actor's exact POV.
cooked: works
hazards: PilotLevelActor silently no-ops when no level viewport resolves — handler must pre-check
GetPilotLevelActor prefers cinematic actor lock over pilot lock — op=get must report lock kind
